component.name: FrostCenter
component.summary: MSI laptop fan control and thermal monitoring for Linux

description.p: FrostCenter is a modern, lightweight GTK3 application designed specifically for MSI laptops on Linux. It communicates directly with the hardware Embedded Controller (EC) via ACPI port I/O (/dev/port), requiring zero out-of-tree kernel modules.

ul.li: Live CPU and GPU temperature and fan RPM monitoring with rolling 60-second Cairo graphs
Multiple fan profiles: Auto, Silent, Basic (offset), and Advanced (interactive curve editor)
Cooler Boost toggle for instant maximum cooling
Battery charge threshold limits (50–100%) to preserve battery longevity
Auto-detection across 130+ MSI laptop motherboards and 21 hardware groups
Integrated community hardware verification and smart diagnostic reporter

description.p: Initial public beta release of FrostCenter.
